authorisation: The Product Owner's mission of 2026-11-06 (D98): complete the remaining reliability-audit work and deliver System Health & Monitoring in the Appliance Admin Console, with controlled TEST migrations behind verified backups and rollback, protected merge and deployment to the test appliance 172.21.96.97 only.
delivery: PR #382 (merged d4675fae): the Admin Console System health page (overview, checks, client connectivity, device findings, history; System section of the sidebar), edged GET /diagnostics/monitor (diagnostics read permission, re-redacted, missing/unreadable/invalid/stale reported as such), the monitor's console snapshot (root:stayconnect 0640, no client IP address) created by install-monitor.sh on fresh installs and upgrades; acctd serialises its writer transactions (accounting ingest, expiry sweep, session limits); migration 0211 (device retention removes an idle device with its own network appearances, idle judged only from recorded timestamps); migration 0212 (0170's emptiness-checked drop of public.pms_providers.auth_key and api_key again, platform migration); baseline regenerated.
findings: Deadlocks: acctd's accounting ingest (ingest_absolute_counters updates the session row, then its entitlement) and its expiry sweep (p6_tick_online_time locks entitlements in id order, then their sessions) run on separate concurrent tickers, a lock-order cycle; 75 of the 97 recorded deadlocks were the expiry pass and the ingest's silent one-by-one fallback explains those nothing else logged. Device retention: every device had its own device_network_appearances rows (ON DELETE NO ACTION) that were never removed, so AD-34 could not prune any device. Legacy PMS columns: 0 rows, no dependent objects, no column-specific grants, no product code reading them.
verification: acctd integration suite including a new test that the expiry sweep and ingest never overlap; retention integration tests as svc_scd with pre-dated records (idle device removed with its appearance; devices seen recently on a network or as a device, and a device with no recorded time, kept; no timestamp written); 0211 applied as iam_v2_owner and down/up; 0212 on a fresh schema, emptied, with a stored secret (kept), twice, and down; edged endpoint tests (redaction, age, stale, missing, invalid); monitor unit tests (43) on Python 3.10 including every query against the current schema; Admin Console page, navigation and app-wide invariant tests; FACTORY_CLEAN_BASELINE = PASS (14,936 facts identical); MIGRATION_LOCATION = PASS; Codex review clean on both heads.
not_touched: Database log privacy (GDPR C5), device timestamps (none back-filled), permissions and roles, networking, PMS configuration and postings, financial behaviour, licences, the production Central.
